paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Adjustable Class 3 Front Lip is designed to fit the BMW M2 G87 2023+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, the Class 3 setup is the most aggressive front aerodynamic package Alpha-N offers for the latest M2 platform.

Drawing inspiration from Alpha-N's earlier motorsport aero programs including the E92 M3 GTS the Class 3 front lip delivers a more aggressive stance while improving airflow management at the front of the vehicle. The multi-piece system consists of a carbon front lip with an adjustable lower splitter, allowing the front aero profile to be visually and functionally enhanced. The lower splitter is supported by a dedicated carbon mounting bracket for a lightweight yet secure assembly.
hl: Manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance
Pre-preg 2x2 twill carbon fibre, sourced from Italy
Multi-piece design — front lip + adjustable lower splitter + carbon mounting bracket
